verdict.rationale: The only evidence of background automation is a 'Scheduled Chats' docs page, known only by its title. That suggests agent or chat runs can be triggered on a schedule rather than interactively. Combined with configurable agents, MCP tools and an Agent Management API (beta), this gives a plausible base for automation, but nothing describes how scheduled runs work or confirms they run unattended. Missing for 10: documented scheduling/trigger mechanics, evidence that runs execute autonomously without a user session, event-based triggers, run monitoring or notifications, and independent hands-on corroboration.
